correctness.rationale: Over every F_q the derivative-squarefree locus is counted exactly from derivative coefficient constraints; in odd characteristic each repeated root is precisely double, rational repeated-root incidences count degrees one and two with the split double roots corrected, and irreducible-quadratic squares supply the remaining degree-two gcds. The three resulting formulas sum to the proven total for each characteristic. Exact table-based field arithmetic enumerates all 94,213 quartics over nine finite fields; this is an independent finite check but not a proof for untested fields.

value.rationale: The full three-stratum census answers the natural joint problem of polynomial squarefreeness and separability of its formal derivative for all finite fields. Quartic degree is the first degree in which squares of irreducible quadratics contribute a new nonrational gcd stratum, requiring an essential correction. The exact independence transition in characteristic three, and strictly positive covariance in every other characteristic, is a nontrivial infinite-family structural consequence.
